question: Which military strategy did Shivaji often use against his opponents?

options.text: Warfare with the help of elephant

solution:
The correct answer is __**Guerrilla warfare**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shivaji Maharaj**, the founder of the Maratha Empire, is renowned for his use of **Guerrilla warfare**, a strategic method of fighting that involves ambushes, raids, and surprise attacks on enemy forces.
 
• This military strategy was crucial for Shivaji as it allowed him to combat larger and better-equipped armies of the **Mughals** and other adversaries effectively.
 
• The terrain of the **Western Ghats**, with its mountainous regions, dense forests, and fortresses, was ideal for implementing Guerrilla tactics. Shivaji’s deep understanding of the geography played a significant role in his success.
 
• Guerrilla warfare emphasized speed, mobility, and deception<
